title: Disaster and emergency support for business
summary: This page provides resources and guidance to help businesses prepare for, manage during, and recover from disasters and emergencies.
intro:
We can help you prepare your business for disasters and emergencies and guide you through your recovery. Explore our resources or book a call with the Service NSW Business Bureau for tailored, one-on-one support.

who_can_apply: Any business owner or employee affected by a disaster or emergency.
what_you_need: A phone number or access to the internet to view resources.
For specific guidance, you may need to download the Hazards Near Me app or access free templates for an emergency management plan.

faqs.q: Who should I call during a natural disaster?
faqs.a: Call NSW SES on 132 500. For a life-threatening emergency, call Triple Zero (000) or TTY – 106.

faqs.q: How can I prepare my business for a disaster?
faqs.a: You can plan ahead using resources like the Hazards Near Me app, creating an emergency management plan, and accessing guidance through Get Ready Business.

faqs.q: What support is available after a disaster?
faqs.a: Support is available for replacing licenses and documents, making insurance claims, getting financial advice, and accessing mental health support.
